On the other side: CheckMate 227 (NCT02477826) and NCT02220894 used ≥14 days and ≥21 days, more permissive than Major surgery washout ≥28 days (+1 against, counted once for the group). A more permissive threshold in a comparable trial shows the value was used, not that it was safe for this regimen.

On the other side: General FDA guidance passages ask that criteria of this kind be justified or kept no more restrictive than needed; they do not add to the score. Issued 2026-07, after this trial started; applied retrospectively, not a standard available when the trial was designed.
